name: Badigui
body:
BADIGUI
CR 13

This immense, sinuous serpent has a broad, tapered head and smooth, gigantic scales cover its body, dark and patterned along the back, fading to a paler underside.

XP 25,600
N Colossal animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +21

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 1, flat-footed 28 (–1 Dex, +27 natural, –8 size)
hp 189 (18d8+108)
Fort +16, Ref +12, Will +10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +22 (6d6+24/19–20 plus grab and pull)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks binding coils, constrict (6d6+24), pull (bite, 20 feet), smother, takedown, thrash

STATISTICS

Str 42, Dex 9, Con 21, Int 2, Wis 15, Cha 2
Base Atk +13; CMB +37 (+41 grapple); CMD 46 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Climb +28, Perception +21, Stealth –8 (+12 when underwater), Swim +28; Racial Modifiers +20 Stealth when underwater

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Binding Coils (Ex)

As a move action, a badigui can transfer a grappled creature of Huge size or smaller from its jaws to its coils. This frees the badigui to make further bite attacks. The coils maintain the grapple as a free action, but don’t gain the usual +5 circumstance bonus and cannot take additional actions for maintaining the hold, such as dealing damage, moving, or pinning the target. If the grapple is successfully maintained, the coils deals constrict damage to the creature. A badigui can hold up to 4 Huge-sized or smaller creatures in its coils.

Smother (Ex)

When the badigui succeeds on a grapple check against a creature holding its breath, the remaining duration that creature can hold its breath decreases by 1d6 rounds. If this reduces the remaining time that the creature can hold its breath to 0 rounds or fewer, the DCs of its suffocation checks increase by 5.

Takedown (Ex)

When the badigui succeeds on a combat maneuver check to grapple or pull a creature, as a swift action it can make another combat maneuver check to trip that creature.

Thrash (Ex)

As a full-round action, a badigui move up to its speed while thrashing it passes through and within 5 feet on either side of its path. When moving on soil or muddy ground (but not stone), any space it moves through becomes difficult terrain for creatures of Huge size or smaller. Underwater, the space it moves through becomes difficult terrain until the start of its next turn. Creatures of Huge size or smaller must succeed at a DC 20 Swim check to move through these affected water spaces; those failing their check are pulled 10 feet underwater and must hold their breath or begin to drown. Huge or smaller creatures in the area take 3d6+12 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 24 Reflex half). The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm lakes and rivers
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

These enormous serpents ply the lazy lakes and rivers in search of prey. They rarely venture onto land, but when they do they leave behind tracks as wide as a wagon or cart, and when rearing up from the water just their upper bodies can stretch 20 to 30 feet. Even other predators know to stay clear of the badigui, as it will devour an unwary crocodile just as readily as it will a wildebeest or zebra coming too close to the water’s edge.
